sections.title: AI content from scratch
sections.desc: AI as a real production environment, not a gimmick: we write the prompts, generate the stills and the footage, then cut it all in Premiere Pro.

works.title: AI teaser intro for an event brand
works.note: The client came to us for AI expertise: a hook intro for a teaser. Concept, generative visuals and motion assembly — from the first idea to the delivered master.

works.title: AI short film — new episode
works.note: An original AI-animated short: concept, frame generation, take selection and assembly in Premiere Pro. Built end to end with neural nets on our own prompts.

works.title: AI host — a video generated from zero
works.note: An English-language vertical where the host is fully AI-generated: the look and the delivery both come from our prompts. Lip-sync, infographics, subtitles and final cut — no human ever stepped in front of a camera.

works.title: Azu — animated series for moms
works.note: An episode of our own vertical animated series: one consistent AI character, prompt-generated scenes, voice-over and a shorts-format cut.

works.title: Fruit drama — viral AI sketch
works.note: A small Pixar-flavoured story with fruit characters: script, frame generation, voice-over and edit — built for viral vertical feeds.

works.title: AI cartoon series: animated narrative
works.note: A short series with an original AI character carrying the story across episodes. Generation, take selection and story assembly in Premiere Pro.

sections.title: International conferences
sections.desc: Hours of raw footage turned into a minute: the strongest shots, the rhythm, the music, the feeling of being in the room.

works.title: Blockchain conference 2024, Dubai — recap
works.note: Hours of footage from a blockchain summit cut down to a one-minute recap. Music-driven pacing, the scale of the event readable in seconds. Client — an international blockchain event organizer.

works.title: Brazil 2025 — conference recap
works.note: Hours of footage from a conference in Brazil: the strongest shots, music and clean transitions with stock inserts — a wrap-up film delivered to the client.

sections.title: Motion design
sections.desc: Animation and graphics in After Effects: movement carries the message, not just decorates it.

works.title: Sports broadcaster — motion package (test assignment)
works.note: A test assignment for a national sports TV network: prove editing and motion skills in a few seconds. The style is deliberately dense — the brief was to pack in as many techniques as possible: graphics, logo animation, tempo work.

sections.title: Shorts / vertical
sections.desc: Vertical short-form under 60 seconds: the pace is set in the first second and holds to the end. Subtitles, light motion design, sound accents, cuts on the rhythm of speech.

works.title: Shorts for a football media channel
works.note: Vertical videos for a sports channel: graphic design and motion accents push the delivery, the cut holds tempo from the first frame.

works.title: Shorts for a business & AI channel
works.note: A short takeaway from a business channel: edit, subtitles, stock inserts, cuts on the rhythm of speech — built for retention.

works.title: Shorts «Levis» — sport meets brands
works.note: A vertical breakdown of how brands cash in on sports news: host on camera, editorial cards, dense subtitles and tempo from second one.

works.title: Shorts «Nike Mind» — unboxing
works.note: Unboxing the Nike Mind sneakers: studio shoot, close-ups, subtitles and a rhythmic cut — a review that holds attention to the last second.

sections.title: Stock-built videos
sections.desc: Footage assembled entirely from stock: shots matched to the voice-over, paced by meaning rather than by beat.

works.title: Stock cut for a voice-over
works.note: A finance video built entirely from stock footage under a voice-over: material selection, pacing driven by the narration, infographics and careful grading.
